variants.name: pin-wave
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished square app icon concept for LocalVoice, a location-aware audio guide that tells interesting local stories while walking or travelling. Flat vector-like bitmap, bold simple silhouette, precise smooth curves, strong contrast, readable as a tiny 16px favicon. Full-bleed square background, centered emblem occupying about 68 percent of image, generous safe margins. Single icon only. No words, labels, typography, device mockup, presentation sheet, watermark, texture, fine details, 3D or drop shadows. The mark must look purpose-designed and balanced. Direction A: combine a recognizable location pin silhouette with an audio waveform cut out of its upper center. Background deep forest green #075747, emblem warm ivory #FFF8E8. The white pin has a short gently pointed lower tip, and three thick green negative-space vertical rounded bars of differing heights inside its wide round upper body. Make the inner waveform clearly legible rather than complicated. Quiet premium travel identity.
